brief:
Israel killed three Palestinians and wounded 21 others in attacks across the Gaza Strip over a 24-hour period, the Palestinian Health Ministry reported Sunday, IMEMC News said.

The fatalities and injuries marked the latest toll from ongoing Israeli military operations in the enclave. The Health Ministry did not specify the locations of the strikes or the circumstances of each incident.
dek: Three Palestinians were killed and 21 others injured as Israel continued its attacks on the Gaza Strip, the Palestinian Health Ministry reported on Sunday.
title: Israeli strikes kill three Palestinians, wound 21 in Gaza
